Title of the Event:  
 One day competition on“ Exhibition of Household Items for Sustainable Environment from Waste 
Materials” for club members sponsored by SPICES an AICTE initiative organized by Arts & Crafts club.

19-4-2023 (Wednesday)

10:30 AM to 4:00 PM

Dr. N.Sudhakar Reddy 
Principal,  
S V College of Engineering, 
Tirupati, A.P. – 517507. 
Event Description:  
 Arts & Crafts club, SVCE with the support from  the department of English, conducted  one day 
competition on “Exhibition of Household Items for Sust ainable Environment from Waste M aterials” for 
club members. Principal Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy started the programme motivating the students to empower the 
spirit of competition in exhibition. He explained the importance of sustainable environment and how to utilize 
the waste material for decoration and house hold items. Club coordinators initiated the conduction of exhibition. 
Students were divided into teams, implemented their ideas in presenting different items including crafts with the 
guidance of club coordinators. T hey exhibited the prepared items and crafts  in and in front of the auditorium. 
Principal, Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy distributed the prizes to the best performers.  

Targeted Audience:  
1stand 2nd Year Students.
